notes: ★ NEW BEST K8B capture after moving antenna to window (2026-05-28). Hardware AGC mode (-G 0, same as k8b_100pct success setup). FIB pass rate 72.8% (vs k8b_v2's 44%, k8b_100pct's 75%) — almost matches the original high-SNR reference. eti-stuff internal SNR 11 dB (vs 8 / 5 / 4 for previous captures). First successful RS decode at this site since k8b_100pct: 22/12960 corrected blocks. Still ~2 dB short of robust video decode quality (k8b_100pct gave 87.3% RS), but cleanly above the 'all-fail' regime that k8b_v2 / k8b_strong / k8b_rust were in. The dramatic improvement is from window-edge antenna placement: PSD outer-5% noise floor dropped 11 dB (from +11 to +0.0), indicating significantly less indoor RF interference and cleaner line-of-sight path to Namsan (~5 km). The Ag mode hardware AGC (vs manual L14/M15/V15) avoids over-driving the front end on the now-stronger signal. Pair of capture: raw I/Q (k8b_v3.iq, 240 MB INT16) + live ETI ground truth (k8b_v3.eti, 15.4 MB, 2506 frames). Both captured within the same RF time window so they share the channel state.

environment.antenna: DIY half-wave dipole — 41 cm × 2 enameled-wire arms (total 82 cm), fed via ~1 m Teflon-insulated twisted-pair feedline (no coax), connected via reused SMA male base from a sacrificed rubber-duck WiFi antenna. Horizontal polarization. Hand-positioned at window edge facing roughly the Namsan transmitter direction (~5 km bearing ~340° from Sinnonhyeon). No LNA.

engineering_observation: Moving antenna from indoor location to window edge dropped indoor RF interference by ~11 dB (PSD outer-5% from +11 to +0 dB) and boosted effective SNR by ~3 dB (eti-stuff estimator 8→11 dB). The improvement was larger from the noise-floor reduction than from absolute signal level. This validates the gotcha #4 observation that indoor reception of VHF Band III at Sinnonhyeon is dominated by adjacent-channel interference and partial-shielding rather than free-space path loss alone.
